The '''First Huntsman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who, along with his sons, was influential in the customs and traditions of the [[Order of Extermination]], a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]]-hunting group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
